## v2026.11.02.1638 — F675-215 Expired Holdings: Microsecond-Safe Cursor and Honest Inventory State (FEATURE IMPROVEMENT / DRAFT / RELEASE HOLD)
**v1638 GitHub:** Draft PR #2439 OPEN/HOLD (base Draft #2433); developer handoff issue #2432; final-SHA CI pending; no merge/deployment.

**Cycle:** Previous Feature Addition v1636 → Current Feature Improvement v1638 → Next Feature Addition v1640 (provisional). Source authority: latest origin/main `a8541927c3a351d980454c66e95a3356c47e0722` re-fetched at start and mid-cycle, AGENTS.md, README.md, English canonical PROJECT_PLAN.md and Korean parity. Docs-only child of unmerged Draft #2433; developer issue #2432. **F675-215 remains PROPOSED, NOT IMPLEMENTED. No merge, Test or Production approval.**

### Confirmed source discrepancy and design decision
- `packages/database/migrations/071-shop-catalog-schema.sql` defines `user_items.expires_at timestamptz`; migration 123 filters expired rows from `shop_my_items_v2` using `clock_timestamp()`; migration 104 explicitly defines expiry as a predicate rather than a scheduled sweep and restamps a single owner/catalog row when quantity rises. An expired positive-quantity row is **current persisted state**, never a purchase history, proof of a refund, or a restorable item. Catalog names/categories are **current** labels, not immutable historical labels.
- **Fresh reproducible runtime-library probe:** `require('./backend/node_modules/pg').types.getTypeParser(1184,'text')('2026-11-02 07:11:01.123456+09')` produced a JavaScript `Date` with `.toISOString()` `2026-11-01T22:11:01.123Z`: the `456` microseconds were lost. The proposed v1636 cursor's PostgreSQL `(expires_at,catalog_id)` key MUST NOT round-trip through `pg`'s default timestamptz→Date conversion, `Date.parse`, `toISOString`, or JS floating-point epoch milliseconds. This is a **verified precision hazard in the library**, NOT evidence that the unimplemented F675-215 has already skipped a row in Production.
- `frontend/src/app/inventory/page.tsx` currently uses `apiOrNull('/api/v1/shop/holdings')` and `holdingsData?.holdings || []`, so a failed active-inventory fetch looks like zero holdings. A new expired disclosure must not reinforce that false-empty state; show independently verified active and expired statuses. The Android app-api currently treats `shop/purchases` as private, not all `shop/holdings` paths. A new archive endpoint needs explicit protection; assess existing active holdings separately without silently changing unrelated A/C runtime code.

### Exact API, cursor and database handoff (P1; not implemented)
- Keep proposed owner-only `GET /api/v1/shop/holdings/expired?limit=20&cursor=...` (1..50, default 20; duplicate/unknown query keys rejected). Return `sourceStatus:'VERIFIED'`, `observedAtUtcMicros` as **fixed-width six-fraction-digit UTC text**, `items` with `expiresAtUtcMicros` and `acquiredAtUtcMicros` **as strings**, `nextCursor`, `hasMore`, and `totalStatus:'VERIFIED'|'NOT_COMPUTED'`. Optional human-display `expiresAt` may be rounded, but is never a cursor key. No JS Date or Number conversion for sorting, cursor claims, SQL predicates or expiry equality. DTO rejects malformed timezone, missing fractional digits, non-finite quantities and duplicate catalog IDs in one page. A verified empty response requires a complete successful owner-filtered query, not a fallback `[]`.
- SQL uses a single captured database `as_of` and read-only `REPEATABLE READ` on **one connection per page**; emit microsecond-precision UTC via `to_char(ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"')`, or an equally tested lossless representation. Filter `held.user_id = trusted_actor AND held.quantity > 0 AND held.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND held.expires_at <= as_of`. Exact order: `ORDER BY held.expires_at DESC, held.catalog_id ASC`; next-page predicate `held.expires_at < :last_expiry::timestamptz OR (held.expires_at = :last_expiry::timestamptz AND held.catalog_id > :last_catalog_id::uuid)`. Both `:last_expiry` and `:last_catalog_id` must come from a verified cursor, not client-visible display timestamps. Fetch limit+1, compute hasMore from the same statement, and never OFFSET. Reject invalid catalog join/source rather than silently dropping rows.
- Cursor v1: authenticated **owner + session fingerprint**, canonical filter/limit, first-page `asOfUtcMicros`, last row's **exact** `expiresAtUtcMicros` and catalog UUID, issued/expiry times (<=5 minutes), HMAC-SHA256 with constant-time MAC verification and versioned key rotation. Strict base64url and 512-byte decoded/encoded bounds; no actor override, raw cursor logs, secrets or unbounded parsing. 400 for malformed/tampered/expired tokens; 409 **only** for a provably changed owner snapshot/revision; otherwise 503 for unverified source. No fabricated owner-row revision. A first-page anchor time does **not** freeze PostgreSQL MVCC across HTTP requests: concurrent expiry restamps may cause omissions/duplicates, even with exact cursor keys. UI explicitly says best-effort; a known stale page offers `Restart list`, never a false `VERIFIED_EMPTY` or guaranteed full archive.
- `totalCatalogHoldings` may appear only if exact `COUNT(*)` is computed from the same page transaction/snapshot as items. The total is **as-of that page only**, not a persistent cross-page count. A page that becomes empty after earlier `hasMore=true` must not be presented as a verified global empty archive; indicate page changed/refresh when provable, otherwise a best-effort end-of-list with warning. Catalog label changes, row deletion, zeroing and restamps require separate regression fixtures.

### User states, privacy, administration and release
- Active inventory and expired disclosure have independent `LOADING`, `VERIFIED_ROWS`, `VERIFIED_EMPTY`, `UNAVAILABLE`, `STALE_PAGE` statuses. An active read failure must show `Active holdings unavailable` rather than `0 items`; the archive must never populate active equipment/avatar counts. New `Restart list / 목록 다시 불러오기` CTA clears cursor/seen rows on 409 and owner/session change; screen-reader focus returns to disclosure heading, error announced via aria-live. KO/EN parity, 320px, 200% zoom, keyboard, >=44px targets, TalkBack/VoiceOver, no forced animation.
- For Next BFF and Android app-api: enforce `Cache-Control: private, no-store`, `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` for 200/400/401/403/409/429/503, HEAD and conditional requests; strip ETag/Last-Modified/Expires, never 304, service-worker/disk caching or public SEO/analytics. On logout/account switch, abort and fence old owner/session requests. Admin gets aggregate cohort>=20 only (precision validation failures, cursor restarts, 409, 503, p95), no individual holdings, raw cursor, catalog ID or SQL timestamps.
- Feature switch `F675_215_EXPIRED_HOLDINGS_ARCHIVE_ENABLED` remains **OFF**. PG17 clean+upgrade, 10,001 distinct holdings and tied microsecond expiries, EXPLAIN index evidence, owner A/B + session switch, malformed cursor, key rotation, expiry boundary, restamp/deletion between pages, 401/403/409/429/503, KO/EN/Android private HEAD/conditional, **zero WLD/item/ledger writes** are required acceptance tests (NOT RUN). Exact-SHA Test, real image/manifest provenance, independent restore, DEV/Test/Production ACL (#993), QA #2391 and finance gates must pass before any staff/cohort rollout; rollback switch OFF then verified image. **DRAFT / RELEASE HOLD.**

## v2026.11.02.1636 — F675-215 Owner Expired Holding Archive (FEATURE ADDITION / DRAFT / RELEASE HOLD)

**Cycle:** Previous Feature Improvement v1634 → Current Feature Addition v1636 → Next Feature Improvement v1638 (provisional). Authority: origin/main `a8541927c3a351d980454c66e95a3356c47e0722` checked at start and during design; canonical AGENTS.md, README.md and this English plan with Korean parity. Documentation-only child of unmerged planning v1634 Draft #2428; developer handoff issue #2432; child Draft PR #2433 OPEN/HOLD. **F675-215 PROPOSED, NOT IMPLEMENTED.** Neither Test nor Production is approved.

### Problem, evidence and scope
- Existing `frontend/src/app/inventory/page.tsx` calls `apiOrNull('/api/v1/shop/holdings')` and substitutes `[]` when the source is unavailable. `backend/src/shop/shop.controller.ts` serves the authenticated holdings route from `shop_my_items_v2`. Migration `123-store-read-models-v2.sql` filters `held.quantity > 0 AND (held.expires_at IS NULL OR held.expires_at > clock_timestamp())`, so expired persisted rows are absent from the active inventory. This is a **source-level UX limitation**, not a confirmed Production data-loss event.
- Migration 071 uses a **single current row** per (user_id,catalog_id); migration 104 may reset that row's expiry on ANY quantity increase, including non-purchase grants. A current expired row is not an immutable past purchase, independent lot, receipt, restoration entitlement or evidence of how the expiry occurred. A row later restamped becomes active and leaves the expired view. Deleted/consumed rows cannot be reconstructed from current holdings.
- V1 goal: let a signed-in member inspect their **currently persisted expired positive-quantity holdings** without confusing them with active inventory or historical transactions. Target users are owners reviewing an item that disappeared from active inventory. Out of scope: historical audit trail, refunds, restoration, re-purchase, compensation, expiry edits, equipment actions, inventory exports and payment flows.

### Entry, UX and state machine
- Entry: `/inventory` under the active inventory, a collapsed `Expired holdings / 만료된 보유품` disclosure and optional count only when independently verified. CTA `View expired holdings / 만료된 보유품 보기`, then `Load more / 더 보기` and `Retry / 다시 시도`. No clickable restore/equip action; never include expired cosmetics in active avatar calculation.
- States: `NOT_LOADED`, `LOADING`, `VERIFIED_ROWS`, `VERIFIED_EMPTY`, `STALE_PAGE`, `UNAVAILABLE`, `FORBIDDEN`. An unavailable upstream 200 with malformed data is `UNAVAILABLE`, not `VERIFIED_EMPTY`. The member sees an observedAt time and explicit “current record, not transaction history” note. `expires_at == observedAt` is expired; null expiry is not expired. `effect_expires_at` is NOT the holding's expiry.
- The server does not infer cause of expiry or promise future availability. Re-stamped rows can move out of the archive between requests. Display “List may change when holdings change” for pagination. Accessibility: Korean/English parity, WCAG 2.2 AA, 320px and 200% zoom, >=44px tap targets, keyboard disclosure/focus, aria-live on load/errors, reduced motion, Android TalkBack/VoiceOver.

### API and database contract (proposal; NOT deployed)
- Authenticated owner-only `GET /api/v1/shop/holdings/expired?limit=20&cursor=<opaque>`; default limit 20, maximum 50, strict single decimal integer 1..50; cursor optional opaque signed token, max 512 bytes, bound to authenticated actor and filters with <=5 minute TTL. Reject duplicates, unknown parameters, malformed cursor and client-supplied actor. No write API. SessionGuard, AuthenticatedGuard, ConsentGuard, throttling; statuses 200 verified, 400 bad request, 401 anonymous, 403 consent, 409 invalidated page snapshot if provably detected, 429 rate limit, 503 unknown source. Never return an unverified 200 or raw SQL errors.
- Response: `sourceStatus:'VERIFIED'`, `observedAtUtcMicros`, `items:[{catalogId,code,name,category,quantity,acquiredAt,expiresAt}]`, `nextCursor|null`, `hasMore:boolean`, `totalStatus:'VERIFIED'|'NOT_COMPUTED'`, optional `totalCatalogHoldings` only if exact full count was computed; all identifiers owner-scoped. Each row is a current owner/catalog holding, not an immutable receipt. No WLD amount, payment key, transaction ID or effect-expiry inferred.
- New forward-only PostgreSQL 17 SECURITY DEFINER **read** function only after trusted actor binding and app-role ACL are proven; transaction `REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY` on a single connection per page, one captured database observation timestamp. Filter `user_id=trusted_actor AND quantity>0 AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at<=observedAt`. Join catalog strictly; missing/inconsistent catalog source fails closed. Order `expires_at DESC, catalog_id ASC`, keyset `(expires_at,catalog_id)` and fetch limit+1; do not use OFFSET. Existing `user_items(user_id,catalog_id)` PK is not enough to prove this sort is fast: measure EXPLAIN on >=10,001 rows, propose `(user_id,expires_at DESC,catalog_id)` partial index only if write/read tradeoff and migration parity are acceptable.
- A cursor may bind the first page's observedAt, but PostgreSQL MVCC snapshots do NOT persist across separate HTTP requests. Strong cross-page consistency would require a separately validated durable owner-row revision/snapshot mechanism; absent that, explicitly label pagination best-effort, detect provable staleness, and never claim no missing/duplicate rows under concurrent restamps. On known revision mismatch return 409 and restart; otherwise surface the limitation. Do not fabricate a revision column or claim a stable archive.
- Privileges: NO direct SELECT/UPDATE grants on user_items, NO ledger or WLD mutation, NO new admin access to individual holdings, NO edits to historical migrations 071/104/123. DEV has previously exhibited moneyverse_app direct protected-table privileges (#993); independently re-measure DEV/Test/Production before implementation. Negative owner A/B and anonymous SQL tests mandatory.

### Privacy, mobile, SEO, administration, metrics and rollout
- Next BFF and Android `frontend/src/app/app-api/v1/[...path]/route.ts` must enforce `Cache-Control: private, no-store`, `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` on success, 400/401/403/409/429/503, HEAD and conditional requests; strip ETag/Last-Modified/Expires, never 304 or cache on device/service worker. Existing app-api privateShopReceipts matcher protects shop/purchases, NOT shop/holdings/expired. Never expose rows in public HTML, sitemap, structured data, client analytics or logs. On logout/account switch, cancel requests and discard prior-owner responses.
- Admin sees only aggregate cohort>=20 counts for archive opens, verified-empty vs source failure, pagination resets, stale responses, p95 latency, and error distribution; no owner list, item-level export or raw cursors. Proposed KPI: p95 <250ms on measured Test fixture, zero archive-induced financial writes, 100% authenticated owner isolation; targets not observed measurements.
- Feature flag `F675_215_EXPIRED_HOLDINGS_ARCHIVE_ENABLED` default OFF; sequence: source/ACL/PG17 parity → isolated exact-SHA Test authenticated member+admin+Android/privacy/finance regression and independent restore → staff → small cohort → broad rollout only with owner approval. Rollback switch OFF first; immutable image rollback if required. Do not alter historic rows, receipts, WLD, ledger, Test or Production during planning.

### P0/P1 developer backlog (4 P0 + 6 P1; no overlap with A/B/C/QA)
1. **P0 OPS1636-01 (Ops/QA):** attest real Test/Production process+image+manifest SHA, symlink provenance, retained rollback artifacts, GitOps authorization and independent restore (#1984/#1088); public version alone is insufficient.

5. **P1 ARCHIVE1636-05 (B/DB):** forward-only owner-scoped read function, observedAt, expiry boundary, index EXPLAIN, no extra grants, re-stamp/zero/null/source ambiguity tests.
6. **P1 ARCHIVE1636-06 (B/API):** bounded validated GET, cursor owner binding/TTL/409 semantics, verified-empty vs 503, 401/403/429, response DTO contract and abuse throttling.
7. **P1 ARCHIVE1636-07 (A/Web):** separate expired disclosure, no active-equipment contamination, explicit loading/empty/unknown/stale, KO/EN WCAG/320px/200% zoom and accessible retry.

## v2026.11.02.1634 — F675-214 Purchase-Impact Source and Replay Truth (FEATURE IMPROVEMENT / DRAFT / RELEASE HOLD)

**Cycle:** Previous Feature Addition v1632 → Current Feature Improvement v1634 → Next Feature Addition v1636 (tentative). Latest origin/main a8541927c3a351d980454c66e95a3356c47e0722, checked start/mid; isolated docs-only child of unmerged Draft #2422, development issue #2421; child Draft PR #2428 OPEN/HOLD. English canonical / Korean equivalent. F675-214 is a PROPOSAL, NOT IMPLEMENTED. Test and Production public /api/version both returned 510dbe6bf4d5c2a8089fc06b480776053da7a2e3 at 05:08 KST, which differs from main; this HTTP identity is not a runtime image/DB/restore attestation. DRAFT / RELEASE HOLD.

### Verified correction: the current purchase path is migration 218, not the 072/165 body
- Source chain: immutable migration 071 defines one public.user_items row per (user_id,catalog_id); migration 104 BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE trigger shop_stamp_item_term resets expires_at for the ENTIRE timed holding when quantity increases. Migration 103 early_event_claim can also increase quantity via an event grant, triggering the same restamp WITHOUT a catalogue purchase. Other writers must be enumerated at implementation time; a restamp is not evidence of a purchase.
- Migration 072 introduced shop_purchase_catalog; migration 165 updated pricing; **migration 218 supersedes the public function** by renaming the previous policy to private shop_purchase_catalog_policy_v215 and wrapping it with economic_command_claim/economic_command_complete. The wrapper binds idempotency to actor, catalogue, quantity hash, command and authoritative ledger/purchase receipt. On an authenticated replay with the same key and matching payload, it verifies the original immutable receipt and returns replayed=true WITHOUT calling the private purchase policy or executing the quantity upsert/trigger again. A mismatched payload or inconsistent receipt must fail, never silently create a second purchase. This is a source correction to v1632, not an observed Production incident.
- DEV-only read-only PostgreSQL check: 146 shop_catalog rows, 2 with non-NULL holding_duration_days, 6 user_items rows, 0 with non-NULL expires_at; migration 218 installed and private policy exists. Effective moneyverse_app EXECUTE on public purchase wrapper=true and private delegate=false; **direct UPDATE account_balances=true, direct SELECT/UPDATE user_items=true, direct SELECT shop_catalog=true in DEV**, contrary to intended least privilege (#993). No Production grant or user-item conclusions follow. Security remediation and positive/negative DB tests are P0; NEVER grant further protected table privileges for the preview.

### Corrected member journey, authority and state machine
- Existing /shop/catalog BuyForm still submits a server action directly. Proposed flow (flag OFF by default): select quantity 1..100 within UI cap → Check purchase impact / 구매 영향 확인 → owner-only verified advisory dialog → Confirm purchase / 구매 확정 or Cancel / 취소. Show actual current member+catalog quantity and expiry at observedAtUtcMicros; distinguish RESTAMPS_ENTIRE_HOLDING, NEW_TIMED_HOLDING and NO_TERM_CHANGE, and show expired existing row distinctly. Explain that a fresh purchase may restamp all units; a gift or another authorized increase may also restamp between reads. Never invent separate lots, exact new expiry, guaranteed price, stock, eligibility or purchase success.
- A 30-second preview age limit, owner/session/consent/catalog/quantity match and discard-on-local-mutation are **UI freshness checks, NOT MVCC continuity, a stock reservation, an optimistic-lock CAS or a promise that no other writer changed the holding**. A different session, logout, account switch, stale data, invalid response or unavailable DB clears the confirm CTA and requires a new GET. The user can cancel without a write. Even a <30s VERIFIED preview may be outdated by a concurrent purchase, event grant, catalogue term edit or inventory/price change; the canonical POST is allowed to reject independently. Avoid implying the preview authorizes any settlement.
- After POST, distinguish VERIFIED_NEW_PURCHASE_RECEIPT (replayed=false), VERIFIED_IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY (replayed=true), REJECTED and RECEIPT_UNVERIFIED. A replay is success of the *original* transaction, not proof of a new expiry reset, new stock decrement or new WLD debit. Never show 'newly extended' from a replay or an advisory GET. Re-read owner holdings after either verified receipt; display the resulting expiry only from a new authoritative read, with as-of timestamp and explicit uncertainty if read fails. A timeout/unknown POST result must be resolved using the SAME original idempotency key/receipt lookup, not a fresh purchase key or blind retry. Preserve existing server action's key lifecycle; do not add preview-derived payment authorization.
- Source errors: 400 malformed/duplicate query; 401 unauthenticated; 403 missing consent; 429 throttled; 503 missing/ambiguous DB source, stale/malformed DTO, inconsistent term/expiry; verified zero holding row is NOT an error. Missing or inactive catalogue may be 404/unavailable without exposing another owner's state; never present an unverified 200. If term is NULL while a preexisting expiry is non-NULL, report UNKNOWN_SOURCE rather than claiming permanence. Existing expired row is not an independent purchase lot.

### Proposed API, DB transaction, security, privacy and UX boundaries
- Keep proposed GET /api/v1/shop/catalog/:id/purchase-impact?quantity=1..100, read-only and owner-scoped. Strict UUID, single canonical integer, no extra/duplicate parameters; SessionGuard + AuthenticatedGuard + ConsentGuard with trusted actor, no client-supplied userId. DTO remains sourceStatus VERIFIED, observedAtUtcMicros, catalogId, requestedQuantity, holdingDurationDays, currentHolding, impact, previewOnly=true, priceStatus NOT_QUOTED, eligibilityStatus NOT_CERTIFIED. Do NOT return economic_command_claim result, commandId, raw purchase key, future expiry or ledger facts in preview.
- A single PostgreSQL 17 REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction on one connection, one captured DB clock_timestamp() and one owner+catalog row plus catalog term/identity; no preview DML, advisory locks, price/stock reservation or idempotency claim. Use current PK(user_id,catalog_id) and shop_catalog PK; any new index requires isolated EXPLAIN and measured write cost. ## v2026.11.02.1632 — F675-214 Catalogue Purchase Expiry-Restamp Impact Preview (FEATURE ADDITION / DRAFT / RELEASE HOLD)

**Cycle:** Previous Feature Improvement v1630 → Current Feature Addition v1632 → Next Feature Improvement v1634 (provisional). Source authority: origin/main a8541927c3a351d980454c66e95a3356c47e0722 (checked at start/mid; recheck before final), AGENTS.md, README.md, English canonical and Korean paired plan. Docs-only isolated child of unmerged Draft #2416; handoff issue #2421; child Draft PR #2422 OPEN/HOLD. F675-214 is a PROPOSAL, NOT IMPLEMENTED. Public Test and Production /api/version both report 510dbe6bf4d5c2a8089fc06b480776053da7a2e3 at 04:09 KST, not current main. The merged Treasury v1620 cutover log attests a specific Production v1619 runtime, not an unrestricted release gate. DRAFT / RELEASE HOLD.

### 1. Source-verified user problem, options, decision
- **Problem/target:** An authenticated member buying an additional timed catalogue item cannot see that the new purchase may reset the expiry timestamp of the **entire existing member+catalog holding**, not just the added units. This matters for understanding the inventory and before spending WLD; it does NOT imply money loss or a confirmed Production incident. Entry is /shop/catalog on the actual catalogue BuyForm; NOT the separate legacy /shop purchase control.
- **Evidence:** frontend/src/app/shop/catalog/catalog-forms.tsx BuyForm currently submits buyCatalogItem directly without a preview/confirmation. Nest POST /api/v1/shop/catalog/:id/purchases invokes shop_purchase_catalog. Immutable migration 071 defines user_items PRIMARY KEY(user_id,catalog_id) and one expires_at; migration 072 shop_purchase_catalog posts canonical ledger transaction and upserts quantity; migration 104 shop_stamp_item_term BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE trigger stamps expires_at = clock_timestamp() + holding_duration_days whenever quantity increases, including repurchases. A decrease does not restamp. Expired rows may still exist even though shop_my_items_v2 hides them; there are no independent purchase-lot expiries. Migration 165 may also add to the same row.
- **Alternatives rejected:** infer per-unit lots from purchase history (untrue), calculate exact post-purchase expiry in the browser (transaction clock unknown), let preview change balances or reserve stock (unsafe), or modify canonical shop_purchase_catalog settlement as part of this planning run. **Chosen V1:** read-only authoritative as-of impact preview plus explicit human confirmation; the existing purchase remains the only settlement authority. No guaranteed price, stock, purchase eligibility or final expiry timestamp is quoted.

### 2. Member journey, CTA, states and time truth
- Entry: /shop/catalog → quantity 1..100 (existing cap may be lower) → "Check purchase impact / 구매 영향 확인" → verified impact dialog → "Confirm purchase / 구매 확정" or "Cancel / 취소". The dialog shows current whole-holding quantity, current holding expiry if verified, catalogue holding term (days), and a plain warning: "Buying more of this timed item restarts the expiry of your entire holding; the exact new expiry is set by the server at purchase." If no existing holding, explain a new timed holding is created. For an indefinite-term item, do not invent an expiry. The currently displayed price is not a binding quote; the existing purchase function independently rechecks price/stock/limit and may reject.
- States: IDLE, LOADING, VERIFIED_RESTAMP, VERIFIED_NEW_TIMED, VERIFIED_NO_TERM, VERIFIED_EXISTING_EXPIRED, STALE (>30 seconds, changed quantity, item, session, consent or owner), AUTH_REQUIRED 401, CONSENT_REQUIRED 403, INVALID_INPUT 400, RATE_LIMITED 429, UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN_SOURCE 503, PURCHASE_PENDING, PURCHASE_RECEIPT_VERIFIED, PURCHASE_REJECTED. Existing expired row remains a row and is explicitly shown as expired at observedAt, never as a fabricated new purchase lot. Preview verification is advisory, NOT a guarantee that a subsequent purchase will succeed.
- When flag ON, never expose an enabled confirm CTA until a fresh VERIFIED preview matches selected catalogId+quantity+member session; on timeout/503/invalid JSON fail closed with Retry. On account switch, logout, consent change or any purchase/use event discard prior preview and require a new read. On flag OFF, retain existing legacy catalogue buy behavior without altering its transaction. Do not promise atomic consistency across the read→POST gap. Only a future single-transaction quote-and-buy contract could guarantee that.

### 3. Proposed Nest read contract and PostgreSQL source
- GET /api/v1/shop/catalog/:id/purchase-impact?quantity=1..100, exactly one quantity query required, strict UUID route, reject duplicate/unknown query keys, noncanonical integers, 0, >100, control bytes and oversized inputs with 400. SessionGuard + AuthenticatedGuard + ConsentGuard, actor from verified server session; no client-supplied actor. Read-only GET, per-member/IP throttling and concurrency caps, 429 Retry-After; 401/403 before source read.
- VERIFIED 200 DTO: {sourceStatus:"VERIFIED",observedAtUtcMicros:"UTC six-digit precision",catalogId:"UUID",requestedQuantity:integer,holdingDurationDays:integer|null,currentHolding:{exists:boolean,quantity:"decimal integer string",expiresAtUtcMicros:string|null,expiredAtObservation:boolean},impact:"RESTAMPS_ENTIRE_HOLDING"|"NEW_TIMED_HOLDING"|"NO_TERM_CHANGE",previewOnly:true,priceStatus:"NOT_QUOTED",eligibilityStatus:"NOT_CERTIFIED"}. currentHolding.exists is derived from authoritative user_items row presence, not the filtered active-holdings view; a missing row is quantity "0", expiry null, expiredAtObservation false. If duration days is null and a previous expiry is present, mark UNKNOWN_SOURCE 503 rather than promise permanence. If term is non-null, a positive-quantity purchase INSERT/UPDATE restamps all units, regardless of previous expiry. Never return an exact future expiryAt, a guaranteed WLD price, a purchase receipt or a future inventory quantity.
- One read-only PostgreSQL 17 REPEATABLE READ transaction on one connection; capture one clock_timestamp() as observedAt and read the actor's single user_items row plus approved shop_catalog holding_duration_days, active flag and id. Validate FK/PK and unexpected duplicate rows; fail 503 on source inconsistency, missing catalogue, invalid duration, ambiguous identity, failed DB read or malformed 200. No DML, advisory locks, stock reservation, payment or idempotency receipt from this GET. Existing user_items PK(user_id,catalog_id) and shop_catalog PK(id) are the proposed lookup paths; do not add an index without isolated EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) and write-amplification evidence. New bounded SECURITY DEFINER read function only after verifying real app-role EXECUTE scope, trusted session→actor binding and cross-owner negative tests; never grant moneyverse_app direct table SELECT/DML. Immutable next-number migration, no edits to 071/072/104.
- **Transaction boundary:** the subsequent existing POST /api/v1/shop/catalog/:id/purchases must continue to mint its own idempotency key and execute the existing canonical DB settlement and trigger; it must NOT accept preview values as authorization, price, expiry, stock or ledger facts. Preview and purchase are separate transactions. Repeated POST idempotency must return the original canonical receipt; never double debit. A successful POST receipt, not the preview, is the only purchase success proof. Preview source failure never mutates WLD/items.

### 4. Web, Android, admin, abuse, SEO and accessibility
- Next catalogue form and same-origin private BFF; Android app-api/v1 exact GET parity. Enforce Cache-Control: private, no-store, X-Robots-Tag: noindex,nofollow, Referrer-Policy: no-referrer, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Vary: Cookie and no ETag/Last-Modified/Expires on success, 400/401/403/429/503, HEAD and conditional requests. Never return 304 for member impact data. The current app-api privateShopReceipts matcher covers shop/purchases, NOT the proposed shop/catalog/:id/purchase-impact; add explicit exact route handling. No preview in public HTML, sitemap, URL query containing user identity, analytics payload, service worker or Android disk cache. Treat malformed/partial upstream success as 503.
- KO/EN equivalent UI, 320px/200% zoom, 44px targets, keyboard-only focus trap/restore in confirmation dialog, aria-live for verified/stale/error, TalkBack/VoiceOver, reduced-motion. User can cancel without a write; no dark pattern. Exact timestamp displayed with KST timezone and explicit as-of; do not confuse holding expiry with item effect expiry or weekly upkeep.
- Admin: no per-member inspection or export. Aggregate preview outcomes, 401/403/429/503, stale/discard, confirmed purchases following a preview, and latency p95 only for cohorts >=20, suppress smaller cells. No analytics event carries catalog-specific owner identity or private expiry. Targets (not measured): p95 read <250ms, no new money write, zero cross-owner exposure, zero double settlement. Per-IP/session rate limit, body/query size limits and abusive retries fail closed.
- Feature switch F675_214_PURCHASE_IMPACT_PREVIEW_ENABLED default OFF; roll out OFF→staff→small cohort only after Test exact candidate SHA, real PostgreSQL ACL/session negatives, actual signed-in purchase E2E, finance ledger reconciliation, independent restore and owner approval. Backend read first, then Next/Android; existing POST remains unchanged. Rollback flag OFF immediately, then immutable artifact rollback if needed; never delete member holdings, alter trigger 104, rewrite historical receipts or roll back ledger data.

## v2026.11.02.1630 — F675-213 Holding-Row Truth, Restamp Semantics and Exact Count Contract (FEATURE IMPROVEMENT / DRAFT / RELEASE HOLD)

**Cycle:** Previous Feature Addition v1628 → Current Feature Improvement v1630 → Next Feature Addition v1632 (provisional). Main at start and source review: 510dbe6bf4d5c2a8089fc06b480776053da7a2e3; recheck main and both plans at midpoint/pre-commit. Documentation-only child of unmerged Draft #2410, handoff issue #2409. This corrects a **proposed, unimplemented** feature; no observed Production item loss or notification incident is asserted. Test public /api/version equals main only at HTTP; Production reports 353c6d5d6ddbc14b1067e84f9c4a127bab1c3834. **DRAFT / RELEASE HOLD**.

### Verified source/schema discrepancy and choice
- **Source evidence:** Immutable migration 071 defines public.user_items PRIMARY KEY (user_id,catalog_id), quantity integer CHECK >=0, one expires_at per holding row. Migration 104 shop_stamp_item_term trigger explicitly restamps expires_at for the **entire member+catalog holding** whenever quantity increases; decrement does not extend expiry. Migration 072 shop_purchase_catalog and migration 165 upsert quantity into the same row; migration 123 shop_my_items_v2 exposes that one holding expiry and separately computed effect_expires_at. Read-only development PostgreSQL inspection confirmed the same PK and CHECK, plus only user_items_pkey and idx_user_items_equipped indexes. DEV aggregate at 2026-11-02 03:xx KST: 6 total rows, 6 positive-quantity rows, **0 non-null expiry rows**, **0 current 72h candidates**. These are DEV-only observations, not Production schema, utilization, demand or absence of future candidates.
- **Defect in v1628 proposal:** grouping by (catalog_id,expires_at), testing “duplicate lots” and promising separate lot expiries conflicts with the actual one-row-per-owner/catalog model. A repeat purchase may move the entire holding's expiry forward; there is no lot ledger from which per-unit expiry can be reconstructed. A zero-result in DEV does not demonstrate the proposed UI works or that Production has no expiring holdings.
- **Rejected:** infer per-purchase lots from shop_purchases (purchases exclude gifts and do not encode authoritative live per-lot expiry), create a new lot table/expiry migration in a planning run, group fictitious duplicate lots, or present units as separate expiring batches. **Selected:** current **catalog holding-row** snapshot, one expiry per catalog holding, with explicit restamp disclaimer. This is an advisory as-of view, not a guaranteed expiry/renewal/notification or historical purchase-lot report.

### Corrected member contract, API and data invariants
- **Audience/entry/CTA:** authenticated, consent-current member, /shop/catalog “Expiring soon / 만료 임박” → 24h (default) or 72h → Refresh / View all holdings / Retry; optional link from /account/notifications. Display “Catalog holdings expiring” rather than “batches” or “units expiring separately”. Label totalCatalogHoldings distinctly from totalUnits; explain “Purchasing more of the same timed item may restart the expiry of the entire holding.” Never promise an automatic reminder or renewal.
- **States:** LOADING, VERIFIED_NONEMPTY, VERIFIED_EMPTY, UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN_SOURCE (503), AUTH_REQUIRED (401), CONSENT_REQUIRED (403), INVALID_QUERY (400), RATE_LIMITED (429), STALE/OFFLINE (>60s or logout/owner/consent/item-mutation switch). Verified empty requires successful authoritative full-set SQL aggregation, not merely an empty top-ten array, an absent row, a missing worker receipt or an empty DEV sample. No optimistic zero on malformed 200 or timeout.
- **Nest GET proposal:** /api/v1/shop/expiry-snapshot?hours=24|72; exactly one optional hours query parameter, default 24; reject unknown/duplicate/oversized/invalid values with 400. SessionGuard+AuthenticatedGuard+ConsentGuard, actor from verified server session only; no client-supplied actor. Read-only GET; per-session/IP rate and concurrency controls; 429 Retry-After; never 304.
- **Revised verified 200 DTO (supersedes v1628 totalGroups and lot grouping):** {sourceStatus:"VERIFIED", observedAtUtcMicros:"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.ffffffZ", windowHours:24|72, totalCatalogHoldings:"decimal bigint", totalUnits:"decimal bigint", hasMore:boolean, items:[{catalogId:UUID,code:string,name:string,categoryCode:string,expiresAtUtcMicros:string,quantity:"decimal bigint"}]}. **No totalGroups or lot IDs.** Every item is exactly one qualifying user_items row, max 10 ordered by expiresAtUtcMicros ASC then catalogId ASC; totalCatalogHoldings=COUNT(*) over **all** eligible rows, totalUnits=SUM(quantity::bigint) over the **same** set, hasMore iff totalCatalogHoldings>10. All count fields decimal strings, never unsafe JS Number. If source identity, join uniqueness, aggregate or serialization cannot be proven, 503, not a partial “VERIFIED” 200. Zero is {totalCatalogHoldings:"0",totalUnits:"0",items:[],hasMore:false}. Product names/categories are snapshot display metadata, not independent expiry proof.
- **SQL contract:** read-only PostgreSQL 17 REPEATABLE READ on one acquired connection; capture exactly one DB clock_timestamp() in a single-row materialized asOf source; filter user_items.user_id=verified actor AND quantity>0 AND expires_at>asOf AND expires_at<=asOf+(windowHours * interval '1 hour'), INNER JOIN shop_catalog on PK. NULL expiry is indefinite and excluded. COUNT and SUM are computed from the same filtered relation as top ten, not a LIMIT 10 subquery. PostgreSQL timestamptz retains microseconds; emit fixed six-digit UTC precision, do not round to JS milliseconds before boundary comparison. Concurrent restamp/purchase/consume after snapshot is not reflected; invalidate UI on known mutation and show as-of time.
- **Ownership and grants:** SECURITY DEFINER is not a substitute for session binding. An EXECUTE grant on a p_actor(uuid) function alone permits arbitrary UUID arguments to a compromised app role; verify a trusted DB identity/session proof or a reviewed equivalent and cross-owner SQL/HTTP negative tests before granting EXECUTE. Never grant direct moneyverse_app table SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE as a shortcut. Check effective role privileges and the migration 318/provenance blockers (#993/#2233/#2345) before proposing an immutable next migration number. No new migration is made here.
- **Index/performance:** existing PK(user_id,catalog_id) is an owner-scope access path; no (user_id,expires_at) index currently exists in inspected DEV. Only propose a partial owner+expiry+catalog index WHERE quantity>0 after EXPLAIN (ANALYZE,BUFFERS) and write-amplification review on an isolated PG17 clone with 10,001 **distinct catalog rows**; do not claim 10,001 duplicate lots or measured p95. Targets: p95 <250ms, <=10 preview rows, exact counts, no lock/write on holdings. Validate overflow-safe numeric aggregation if schema volume can exceed bigint; do not silently wrap.
- **Web/Android/SEO/a11y:** same-origin private Next BFF and exact Android app-api path, private/no-store/noindex/nofollow/no-referrer/nosniff before auth on GET/HEAD/errors/conditional; strip ETag/Last-Modified/Expires and forbid 304. No private inventory in public HTML, sitemap, URLs, analytics or disk cache. Validate all DTO fields and bounded strings, discard cross-account/stale responses, KO/EN equivalent wording, 320px/200% zoom, 44px targets, keyboard/aria-live/TalkBack and reduced motion. Distinguish holding expiry from effect expiry and suspension. No fabricated per-lot details or deep links.
- **Admin/KPI and rollback:** flag F675_213_EXPIRY_SNAPSHOT_ENABLED defaults OFF; read-only aggregate adoption, VERIFIED_EMPTY/NONEMPTY/503, 401/403/429, stale drops, latency and top-ten truncation, cohort>=20 and small-cell suppression. Zero member-level export/impersonation. p95 and availability targets are unmeasured. **Cycle:** Previous Feature Improvement v1626 → Current Feature Addition v1628 → Next Feature Improvement v1630 (provisional). Authoritative origin/main 510dbe6bf4d5c2a8089fc06b480776053da7a2e3 checked at start and midpoint against AGENTS.md, README.md, both integrated plans, actual frontend/backend/app-api/DB, open GitHub PRs and QA. Docs-only branch stacked on **unmerged Draft #2402**, developer handoff **#2409**. F675-213 is **PROPOSED, NOT IMPLEMENTED**. Test public version API equals main, but this does not certify immutable runtime image/DB/E2E/restore; Production reports 353c6d5d6ddbc14b1067e84f9c4a127bab1c3834. **DRAFT / RELEASE HOLD.**

### 1. Problem, scope and alternatives
- **Audience/need:** Authenticated, consent-current members need a trustworthy **current** view of their own holdings that will expire in 24 or 72 hours, independently of the unimplemented F675-205–212 notification settings and future calendar. A calendar candidate is not an item inventory. No new purchase, renewal, use, equip, trade, money or worker action is authorized.
- **Observed code:** Next /account/notifications currently exposes goal/NPC settings and inbox; /shop/catalog renders holding expires_at separately from effect_expires_at. Nest GET /api/v1/shop/holdings calls shop_my_items_v2(actor) and materializes all current holdings. Immutable migration 123 filters positive-quantity, unexpired user_items, but uses multiple clock_timestamp() evaluations and returns unbounded rows; it has neither one-asOf exact 24/72h summary nor complete-scan evidence. This is a source-level design gap, **not proof of missed expiries or a Production breach**.
- **Alternatives rejected:** browser-side filtering of the entire holdings response (unbounded, race-prone); future holdings forecasting; guessing expired items from missing rows; creating a write-side notification/ledger flow. **Selected:** one read-only, server-authoritative, bounded summary of currently active held-item expiry, with a verified-empty distinction and a top-ten preview.

### 2. Member journey, states and API contract
- **Entry:** /shop/catalog → “Expiring soon / 만료 임박” section; contextual link from /account/notifications → /shop/catalog (no fabricated per-item deep link). Default 24 hours; segmented 24/72 hours; Refresh, View holdings, Retry. Show “As of [KST time]”; changing hours invalidates prior response. This does not enable digest opt-in, change weekday/snooze/category policy, or assert a reminder will be created or delivered.
- **States:** LOADING, VERIFIED_NONEMPTY, VERIFIED_EMPTY (only after complete authoritative scan), UNAVAILABLE (503), CONSENT_REQUIRED (403), AUTH_REQUIRED (401), RATE_LIMITED (429), STALE/OFFLINE (>60s or account/policy switch), INVALID_QUERY (400). Never convert malformed 200, missing row, truncated result, unknown source or timeout to VERIFIED_EMPTY. A holding expiring at the observation instant is excluded; a holding expiring exactly at the window end is included. NULL expires_at is indefinite and excluded. Distinguish holding expires_at from effect_expires_at, maintenance suspension, and shop catalog sale end.
- **Proposed Nest GET:** /api/v1/shop/expiry-snapshot?hours=24|72; strict single unique hours parameter (default 24), reject duplicate, zero, 73, nondecimal, malformed encoding, unknown parameters and oversized query with 400. Existing SessionGuard + AuthenticatedGuard + ConsentGuard; server-derived actor only, no client owner UUID. Read-only, no CSRF mutation. Rate target <=30 requests/min per session+IP with bounded server concurrency, 429 Retry-After.
- **Proposed verified 200 DTO:** {sourceStatus:"VERIFIED", observedAtUtcMicros:"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.ffffffZ", windowHours:24|72, totalHoldingRows:"decimal bigint", totalUnits:"decimal bigint", totalGroups:"decimal bigint", hasMore:boolean, items:[{catalogId:UUID, code:string, name:string, categoryCode:string, expiresAtUtcMicros:string, quantity:"decimal bigint"}]}. Items <=10, ordered by expiresAtUtcMicros ASC then catalogId ASC, grouped by exact (catalog_id, expires_at) to avoid duplicate lots. total* are exact across the entire qualifying set, not the ten-row sample; hasMore iff totalGroups>10. No purchase prices, internal owner IDs, ledger IDs, raw claims, effects or private debug traces. A verified zero has all counts "0", items [], hasMore false. No pagination/cursor in v1; member can inspect complete holdings on the existing shop page.

### 3. Database, concurrency and security boundary
- **Source and snapshot:** A future reviewed SECURITY DEFINER read model (name provisional: shop_expiring_holdings_summary) reads public.user_items + public.shop_catalog under a **single PostgreSQL 17 read-only REPEATABLE READ snapshot**, captures DB clock_timestamp() **once** as an exact UTC microsecond observation, filters actor-owned quantity>0 and held.expires_at > asOf AND <= asOf + hours, and aggregates full counts and top ten in the **same** snapshot. Never use effect_expires_at, local JS Date millisecond rounding, the future digest schedule or a missing receipt as an item-expiry oracle. Check that the underlying row identity/quantity semantics and owner binding are valid before implementing; if unprovable, 503 and BLOCKED, not a permissive SQL fallback.
- **Indexes/constraints:** Before any new migration, inspect actual latest migration IDs, schema, active grants and EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) on a disposable PostgreSQL clone; consider an owner+expiry+catalog_id partial index WHERE quantity>0, subject to real table/constraint compatibility. Enforce nonnegative quantities and safe bigint SUM; serialize decimal strings, not JS unsafe numbers. If a new function/migration is approved, forward-only immutable migration, REVOKE PUBLIC and direct moneyverse_app table DML, grant only reviewed EXECUTE, fixed search_path, strict actor/session binding. App-role callable p_actor alone is **not** DB-proof of ownership; require independent cross-owner role and HTTP tests and do not expose a user-controlled actor.
- **Isolation and performance:** One consistent asOf for every qualifying row; a concurrent purchase/consumption after snapshot does not retroactively alter the returned snapshot. Show observation timestamp, invalidate on account switch or item mutation; stale after <=60 seconds. No background scan, no write, no row-level lock on item mutations. Proposed p95 <250ms and <=10 top rows at 10,001+ holdings are **TEST TARGETS**, not measured production facts. No new persisted personal snapshot, export, materialized view or audit PII.

### 4. Web, Android, admin, SEO and analytics
- **Private transport:** Nest, Next BFF and Android app-api exact path must enforce private/no-store/noindex/nofollow/no-referrer/nosniff before auth guards, on GET/HEAD, 200/400/401/403/405/429/503 and upstream failures; remove ETag, Last-Modified and Expires, never 304, no CDN/Android disk caching, no owner data in URL/logs/sitemap/public HTML. Validate complete response schema and bound arrays/text before rendering; a malformed HTTP 200 becomes 503 UNVERIFIED, not empty or actionable.
- **Accessibility/mobile:** 320px and 200% zoom, >=44px targets, keyboard/focus, screen-reader announced count/status, TalkBack, reduced motion, KO/EN equivalent copy, 24/72 selector, visible observed-at and stale/Retry. Do not show fake item detail link, guaranteed expiry outcome or auto-renew CTA. Use existing shop holdings navigation.
- **Admin:** Read-only, aggregate-only telemetry: eligible opt-in-independent usage, VERIFIED_EMPTY/NONEMPTY/UNAVAILABLE, 401/403/429/503, stale discard, p50/p95 and top-ten truncation. Suppress cohorts <20 and small cells; no member-level export or impersonation. Feature flag F675_213_EXPIRY_SNAPSHOT_ENABLED defaults OFF. Proposed targets: >=99% verified source success and p95 <250ms under isolated load; unmeasured until real tests.

2. **P0 SEC1628-02:** effective app-role privileges and session→actor SQL proof, cross-owner negatives, migration ID collision/provenance (#993/#2233/#2345).

6. **P1 SNAP1628-06 (B/API):** GET DTO, strict query, actor/consent/rate/503 fail-closed and contract tests.
7. **P1 SNAP1628-07 (A/Web):** shop section, optional notifications link, truthful verified/empty/stale/error UI, no fabricated links.
8. **P1 SNAP1628-08 (C/Android):** app-api private edge and malformed-200/HEAD/304/owner-switch tests, TalkBack.
9. **P1 SNAP1628-09 (A/B/Admin):** flag OFF, cohort>=20 telemetry, staff→cohort rollout, audit and flag-first rollback.

## v2026.11.02.1626 — F675-212 Schedule Preview Temporal Truth and Receipt Boundary (FEATURE IMPROVEMENT / DRAFT / RELEASE HOLD)

**Cycle:** Previous Feature Addition v1624 → Current Feature Improvement v1626 → Next Feature Addition v1628 (provisional). Latest origin/main 510dbe6bf4d5c2a8089fc06b480776053da7a2e3 checked at start and midpoint against AGENTS.md, README.md, canonical English/Korean plans, actual Next/Nest/app-api/DB, GitHub PRs and QA. Documentation-only child of unmerged Draft #2397 (head eba17f20d4fe92d71d05f72368e087468786fe81), developer handoff #2396; new Draft #2402 and existing handoff issue #2396. F675-205–212 are **PROPOSED / NOT IMPLEMENTED**. Public Test version API now reports 510dbe6... equal to main, but this is NOT immutable running-image, database migration, authenticated exact-SHA E2E or independent-restore attestation; Production reports 353c6d5... and differs. **DRAFT / RELEASE HOLD**.

### Source-backed defect and selected correction
- **Observed boundaries:** The real /account/notifications Next page only renders goal/NPC preference and inbox; Nest notification.controller.ts has inbox/read routes, no proposed digest calendar/worker. The app-api catch-all explicitly treats shop/purchases as private but not the proposed shop/expiry-digest/schedule-preview path. Migration 123 shop_my_items_v2 calls clock_timestamp() separately and cannot prove a future digest scan. These are code observations, not evidence of a real missed notification or data leak.
- **Design defect A — configuration vs execution:** v1624 mixes date status CONFIGURED_CANDIDATE with claimEvidence VERIFIED_EVALUATED/NOT_EVALUATED, and marks sourceStatus VERIFIED. A valid snapshot proves *configuration at the observation time*, not that a future worker will run, a scan was complete, or that today's worker has already run. A calendar cannot silently treat a missing receipt as NOT_EVALUATED, no expiring items, failed delivery, or a guaranteed future dispatch.
- **Design defect B — today is time-dependent:** Today before 09:00, during 09:00–11:00, after 11:00, and after an immutable claim are different. A same-day preference PUT after a claim must not rewrite historical outcome. Snooze/resume is effective-dated, so using current flags for all future dates can misrepresent pending changes. The proposed window boundary is **[09:00,11:00) KST**, subject to approval in worker policyVersion; 11:00 exactly is outside. Do not infer a completed scan merely because the window elapsed.
- **Design defect C — policy drift is not self-detecting:** REPEATABLE READ yields a consistent source snapshot, not a guarantee that settings remain current after commit. Without an explicit expected revision from the caller, a GET cannot know the caller's prior version and must not fabricate 409 PREVIEW_POLICY_CHANGED. A valid 200 is an as-of advisory with a short freshness bound, not a durable prediction.
- **Rejected:** expanding selected weekdays, making extra cron runs, scanning future holdings, presenting green “safe/covered” badges, and inferring scan outcome from an absent row. **Selected:** two independent dimensions per day: verified configuration decision and independently verified execution evidence (today only), with a strict source-revision contract and fail-closed UNKNOWN.

### Member behavior and exact API contract (proposed)
- **Entry:** Signed-in, consent-current /account/notifications → Preview 14 days (optional 7), Refresh, Edit weekdays, Edit snooze, Edit lookahead, Review categories, Retry. Keep 14 consecutive KST calendar dates from one PostgreSQL observedAt, including today; 7 returns exactly 7. Existing configuration statuses CONFIGURED_CANDIDATE, NOT_SELECTED_WEEKDAY, PAUSED_BY_SNOOZE, DIGEST_DISABLED, CATEGORY_REVIEW_REQUIRED and UNKNOWN remain *configuration decisions*, never evidence of delivery. CONSENT_REQUIRED is pre-auth UI only; invalid consent GET returns 403 and no member calendar.
- **Add separate executionStatus for each date:** FUTURE_NOT_OBSERVED (every date after today, regardless of settings), TODAY_PRE_WINDOW_UNVERIFIED (before 09:00 without receipt), TODAY_WINDOW_UNVERIFIED (09:00 inclusive to 11:00 exclusive without receipt), TODAY_WINDOW_ELAPSED_UNVERIFIED (11:00 onward without receipt), TODAY_VERIFIED_EVALUATED (only a valid immutable same-owner/day fully evaluated claim), TODAY_VERIFIED_SKIPPED (only a valid skip claim; **not** a holdings scan), or UNKNOWN (claim source missing/ambiguous). A verified receipt with a *previous* preference/policy revision must be labeled “already evaluated under earlier settings”; preserve its historical revision, never rewrite to match current configuration. Never show today's executed state for a future date.
- **DTO:** Owner-only Nest GET /api/v1/shop/expiry-digest/schedule-preview?days=7|14, Next private BFF and Android app-api. Existing sourceStatus VERIFIED/PARTIAL is expressly **configuration-source validity only**; add observedAtUtcMicros (exact six digits), todayKstDay, preferenceRevision, consentGeneration opaque token, policyVersion, sourceRevision (session-scoped opaque), effectiveScheduleVersion and per-day {kstDay,weekdayIso,configurationStatus,executionStatus,executionEvidenceVersion:null|string,subjectToChange:true}. Never send raw owner UUID, member settings, items, claims or consent secret. claimEvidence from v1624 is superseded by executionStatus; do not claim a VERIFIED_EVALUATED state without the full F675-208/211 receipt source. If no approved receipt model exists, executionStatus UNKNOWN for today; future always FUTURE_NOT_OBSERVED.
- **Revision semantics:** A caller MAY send an exact opaque X-Preview-Expected-Revision header from its previous owner/session read. Compare to the verified sourceRevision inside the read transaction; mismatch returns 409 PREVIEW_POLICY_CHANGED with no calendar. Without the header, return current as-of snapshot or 503 if source unverifiable; do **not** manufacture a 409 for a hypothetical post-read race. Reject malformed, repeated or foreign-session expected revisions (400/403 as appropriate), no ETag/304, never put revisions in URL or analytics. Invalidate client preview immediately after a successful preference edit, logout, consent change, account switch or policy change; 60-second TTL is an upper bound, not a freshness guarantee. Offline renders STALE, not VERIFIED.
- **Temporal computation:** Read-only PostgreSQL 17 REPEATABLE READ with a single DB clock_timestamp() observation, UTC microsecond text and KST date/ISO weekday derived from that one observation. Apply verified effective-dated opt-in/consent, snooze/pending resume, selected weekdays and published category registry separately for each date; do not silently restore old snooze after re-consent. A worker receipt is checked against its *own* historical consent generation, KST day, asOfUtcMicros, policyVersion, category registryVersion, preferenceRevision and complete-scan outcome, not current revision. Missing or conflicting sources return 503 PREVIEW_SOURCE_UNVERIFIED or PARTIAL+UNKNOWN only where verified global source permits per-day uncertainty. No future holdings lookup, new table, migration, index, worker, writes or direct moneyverse_app SELECT/DML grants; verify actual schema and identity boundary (#993/#2233/#2345).
- **Truthful UI and accessibility:** For candidate days: “Configured as a possible digest day; no alert is guaranteed.” For today with elapsed window/no receipt: “No verified processing record available,” **not** “No items expiring” or “Failed to send.” For historical receipt under earlier settings: “Today's run used an earlier saved setting.” Preserve F675-211 theoretical schedule-gap warning; it is not observed loss. KO/EN, 320px/200% zoom, 44px targets, keyboard and screen-reader text status, aria-live, TalkBack, reduced motion, loading/401/403/409/429/503/offline/STALE. Default OFF.
- **Privacy and operations:** Protect the exact proposed shop/expiry-digest/schedule-preview path at the actual Next and Android edges **before guards** on GET/HEAD, success/error, gateway errors and conditional requests: private/no-store, noindex/nofollow, no-referrer, nosniff, remove ETag/Last-Modified/Expires, never 304. No settings/receipt in logs, public HTML, sitemap, client/Android disk or per-member analytics. No admin impersonation/export; cohort>=20 and small-cell suppression for configuration-preview views, UNKNOWN vs VERIFIED_EVALUATED rates, 409/503, stale drops and p95. These are design targets, not measured KPIs.

### Prioritized development handoff and release gates
1. **P0 OPS1626-01:** independently attest immutable running Test/Production SHA, rollback artifact, resources and restored backup (#1984/#2171); public Test version equals main **only at HTTP endpoint**, not full release evidence.
2. **P0 SEC1626-02:** prove actual F675-205–211 preference/receipt/registry schema, consent generation, role grants and cross-owner EXECUTE negatives (#993); resolve duplicate 318 (#2233) and official Test fiscal provenance (#2345) before schema work.
3. **P0 FIN1626-03:** independently resolve crafting ledger #2330, stock fabricated fills #2340, season-settle app-role EXECUTE #2357, Treasury/NPS/Mint/CB funded settlement #2366; this planning PR touches none of their runtime.
4. **P0 REL1626-04:** QA #2398 says broad release-policy 196/196 on its **unmerged candidate** but backend 2 FAIL, audit 9 advisories and Test/restore evidence remain; require complete official exact-SHA authenticated two-owner E2E, real PostgreSQL, negative ACL, private-edge, migration/finance and independent restore before promotion.
5. **P1 TRUTH1626-05 (B/DB):** one-asOf effective-date projection and historical receipt source verification; fail closed on unknown schema, zero writes/direct grants.
6. **P1 TRUTH1626-06 (B/API):** separate configurationStatus/executionStatus, strict 7/14, optional revision precondition, 400/401/403/409/429/503 and 09:00/11:00 truth boundaries.
7. **P1 TRUTH1626-07 (A/Web):** accessible calendar and distinct unverified/today/previous-setting copy, BFF, 60s stale, no success-shaped fallback.
8. **P1 TRUTH1626-08 (C/Android):** exact app-api private path before guards, 304 suppression, TalkBack/offline/account-switch/consent fencing; coordinate with separate C #2401/#2395.
9. **P1 TRUTH1626-09 (A/B/Admin):** feature OFF, aggregate cohort>=20 KPIs, audited staff→cohort rollout and flag-first rollback without deleting receipts.
10. **P1 TRUTH1626-10 (QA):** isolated PG17 clean/upgrade, >=10,001 synthetic holdings proving no inventory scan, >=100 08:59:59.999999/09:00:00/10:59:59.999999/11:00:00 and KST midnight/Sun→Mon/year-edge fixtures, >=100 concurrent PUT/worker/consent/registry revision races, >=100 owner/forged token negatives, days 7/14/0/15/duplicate and expected-revision mismatch, >=50 Android HEAD/304/offline/account-switch tests, 320px KO/EN/TalkBack, zero item/WLD/ledger delta. **ALL FEATURE ACCEPTANCE TESTS PROPOSED, NOT RUN.**
- **Rollout/rollback:** Isolated developer A/B/C/QA branches, test-first, official Test exact candidate SHA, migration/ACL/finance/backup gates, operator signoff, OFF→staff→cohort; rollback flag OFF then verified immutable artifact, never mutate historic claims. External independent references newly acquired/verified/deduplicated/classified **0**, cumulative approved **UNKNOWN / 10,000**, gate **BLOCKED / IN PROGRESS**. **No main merge, runtime, database, WLD, ledger, item, Test or Production mutation.**

## v2026.11.02.1624 — F675-212 Member Expiry-Digest 14-Day Schedule Preview (FEATURE ADDITION / DRAFT / RELEASE HOLD)

**Cycle:** Previous Feature Improvement v1622 → Current Feature Addition v1624 → Next Feature Improvement v1626 (provisional). Remote main `3d5e321c3d1221febff677469fecdfcb3cf42e7d` checked start/mid with AGENTS.md, README.md, English/Korean plans, Next/Nest/app-api/DB and GitHub QA. Docs-only stacked on unmerged Draft #2388; handoff issue #2396 and Draft #2397. F675-205–212 PROPOSED, NOT IMPLEMENTED. Test `e39af10f6a876f56b40b7e5a070cdb3dcb61d699` and Production `353c6d5d6ddbc14b1067e84f9c4a127bab1c3834` differ from main. DRAFT / RELEASE HOLD.

### Purpose, alternatives, user flow and states
- **Audience/problem:** Signed-in, consent-current members configuring the proposed holding-expiry digest cannot see how opt-in, F675-207 24/72h lookahead, F675-209 1/3/7-day snooze, F675-210 category review and F675-211 weekdays combine across upcoming dates. F675-211's theoretical coverage-gap warning is not a calendar. **Propose a read-only advisory 14-day schedule**, never an actual item-expiry, worker-run, inbox-creation, dispatch or device-delivery forecast. Inspected `frontend/src/app/account/notifications/page.tsx` and Nest `backend/src/notification/notification.controller.ts` lack this feature; migration 123 `shop_my_items_v2` is not a future worker oracle.
- **Alternatives:** Browser/Android-only computation rejected for stale cross-device preferences, consent and timezone drift; future holdings scan with promised alerts rejected for mutable items/category and privacy/CPU. **Selected:** one server-authoritative PostgreSQL preference/policy read snapshot, no holdings scan, new worker, table, migration or write by default. Unverifiable proposed prerequisites fail closed.
- **Entry/CTA:** `/account/notifications` → **Preview next 14 days**, **Refresh**, **Edit weekdays**, **Edit snooze**, **Edit lookahead**, **Review categories**, **Retry**. PostgreSQL KST today through today+13 inclusive. Each date has ISO weekday 1..7 and `CONFIGURED_CANDIDATE`, `NOT_SELECTED_WEEKDAY`, `PAUSED_BY_SNOOZE`, `DIGEST_DISABLED`, `CONSENT_REQUIRED`, `CATEGORY_REVIEW_REQUIRED` or `UNKNOWN`. Planned 09:00–11:00 KST window is not a delivery promise. Today is `TODAY_OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED` without independently verified immutable owner/day receipt; even a receipt does not prove device delivery. Do not project past receipts into future. Loading, VERIFIED, PARTIAL, 401/403/409/429/503, offline, STALE after 60s and account-switch discard; preserve v1622 coverage-risk warning.
- **Decision order:** consent validity → opt-in → effective-dated snooze/pending resume → ISO weekday → published category registry READY/REQUIRES_REVIEW → configured candidate. Unknown/disabled/snoozed never means zero expiring items. Verified lookahead is context only, not item eligibility. Future settings can change: `subjectToChange:true`. Use PostgreSQL IANA `Asia/Seoul` calendar arithmetic, not browser locale or fixed 24h milliseconds.

### API, DB, security, UX and operations
- **Nest owner GET:** `/api/v1/shop/expiry-digest/schedule-preview?days=14`; days 7/14 only (default 14); reject repeated/unknown params, client owner IDs and 0/15 with 400. SessionGuard, AuthenticatedGuard, ConsentGuard, owner from server session. Verified 200 contract: `{sourceStatus:'VERIFIED',observedAtUtcMicros:string,todayKstDay:string,policyVersion:string,preferenceRevision:string,sourceRevision:string,lookaheadHours:24|72,workerWindowKst:{start:'09:00',end:'11:00'},scheduleRiskStatus:'POTENTIAL_GAP'|'NO_STATIC_GAP_DETECTED'|'UNKNOWN',days:[{kstDay:string,weekdayIso:number,status:string,subjectToChange:boolean,claimEvidence:'NOT_EVALUATED'|'VERIFIED_EVALUATED'|'UNKNOWN'}],expiresAtUtcMicros:string}`. Source revision is opaque, session-scoped and non-reversible. Never expose owner UUID, session/consent secret, raw category choices, item names/counts or other owners' receipts.
- **Truth:** missing/unverified preference, snooze, category registry, worker policy or DB permissions → 503 `PREVIEW_SOURCE_UNVERIFIED`, never 200 empty calendar. If overall provenance verified but one future date indeterminate → `sourceStatus:'PARTIAL'`, date UNKNOWN with reason, not VERIFIED. Policy drift → 409 `PREVIEW_POLICY_CHANGED` and Refresh; expired consent 403, owner rate-limit 429. CONSENT_REQUIRED is a pre-auth UI prompt only; an expired-consent API must not return a 200 calendar. A candidate is not worker coverage or item eligibility.
- **Database:** PostgreSQL 17 read-only REPEATABLE READ transaction with one authoritative `clock_timestamp()` and six-digit UTC microsecond text, consistent KST date and effective-dated preferences. Verify actual owner PK/FK, canonical weekday set, shared revision, pending snooze, published registryVersion and worker policyVersion before coding. F675-205–211 schema is still proposed; no speculative migration number, new table/index or app-role SELECT/DML grant. SECURITY DEFINER UUID argument alone does not authenticate owner (#993). No preference, notification, worker claim, WLD, ledger or item mutation. Resolve duplicate migration 318 (#2233) and official Test provenance (#2345); EXPLAIN/BUFFERS before indexing.
- **Web/Android/privacy/SEO/a11y:** Next private same-origin BFF `/api/shop/expiry-digest/schedule-preview` and Android `/app-api/v1/shop/expiry-digest/schedule-preview`, strict response DTO, malformed upstream 200 → 503. Inspected app-api makes `shop/purchases` private but not proposed `shop/expiry-digest`. Enforce exact private path before guards for GET/HEAD, 400/401/403/409/429/503/502/504 and conditional requests: `Cache-Control: private, no-store`, `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, remove ETag/Last-Modified/Expires, forbid 304. No settings in URL except days enum, sitemap, public HTML, logs, analytics, localStorage or Android disk. Cancel/discard old responses on logout/account/consent/sourceRevision change. 320px/200% zoom, >=44px targets, semantic textual calendar, keyboard/focus/aria-live, KO/EN, Android TalkBack and reduced motion.
- **Admin/abuse/KPI:** `inventory_expiry_digest_schedule_preview` default OFF, no admin impersonation/member-level preview/export/edit. Owner GET rate target <=10/min after load test, no raw member/selection/date logs. Aggregate cohort>=20 with small-cell suppression: adoption, UNKNOWN/409/503, p95, stale drops and gap-warning views. Candidate count ≠ sends. p95<300ms, zero cross-owner exposure and zero WLD/ledger/item writes are TARGETS, not measured.
